// A regular lattice of axis-aligned cells filling a spatial bounding region.
// CellCounts gives the number of cells per axis; node counts are one greater
// per axis. Cell (0, 0, 0) touches the minimum corner of Bounds
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Regular_grid).
type RegularGrid3D
    implements IValue
{
    Bounds: Bounds3D;
    CellCounts: IntegerVector3;
}
